name: f05-fragment-answerable
description: SYNTHETIC. The canonical expressive case: a fragment that the immediately preceding partner turn makes readable. Tests that conversation context is actually used, and that evidence cites the turns it came from.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: 明日の病院、何時だった？

expect.notes: A reading around 10時 is expected. 10日 is a legitimate second reading and should not be penalised — the point is that SOMETHING grounded in the preceding turn is produced, with evidence pointing at it, not that one exact string appears.
